- CHANGED - The pivot point of the ruler to be on the end for easier handling

- FIXED - A bug when sometimes a bone was selected, but could not be moved with the gizmo.
- FIXED - A bug when bones could not be selected while it was intersecting another model
- FIXED - VR hands stayed visible in Desktop mode
- FIXED - Environment rotation was not saved properly and reseted after any button press
- FIXED - When selecting some feet preset scenes the feet was not poseable after clicking "start posing"
